The '''Second Age of the Kentra''' was a prophesied time envisaged by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Michael Tandre]] for the [[Kentra]] before he [[Death/Legends|died]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agents fulfilled the prophecy.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>
